goal: Aggressively reduce desktop native YOLO preview latency and IPC wait in the scanner pipeline.
constraints: preserve current desktop YOLO settings binding
acceptanceCriteria: preview native YOLO no longer depends on per-frame PNG roundtrip
inferredAssumptions: Preview-stage accuracy may trade slightly for latency as long as capture-stage output quality does not regress.
The main user pain is runtime latency, not configuration coverage.
